96. A market intermediary shall not carry on business for
which it is licensed under this Chapter, without the written
consent of the Commission if it does not meet the minimum
financial  requirements  as  may  be  specified  by  the
Commission  or  as  may  be  provided  in  the  rules  of  an
exchange.
